instruction: Change the slide size to A4 format in the active presentation

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide size to A4 format (210mm x 297mm = 7772400 x 10826700 EMUs). Evaluator checks if the presentation dimensions match A4 size with 1% tolerance.
